nativeDirs: .aider (default home dir of the plain CLI)

contained.evidence: CLI not installed (`command -v aider` finds nothing). Runner and shim source only; nothing executed.

runnerEvidence.finding: stateDir = opts.stateDir, else `$TMPDIR/aider-sessions` when the env has MONOMIND_ORG_ROLE and TMPDIR (and MONOMIND_AIDER_STATE_DIR is unset), else defaultStateDir() = MONOMIND_AIDER_STATE_DIR || homedir()/.monomind/aider-sessions (shared).

In shim mode the conversation JSON and aider's own chat_history_file and input_history_file are placed under state_dir (os.makedirs mode 0700). Repo-map/tags cache, analytics and litellm caches are not redirected by the shim.

The aider python is found from the entry point's shebang, then `UV_TOOL_DIR || (env.HOME || homedir())/.local/share/uv/tools`; with a private HOME the uv tool lookup would miss the real install, so MONOMIND_AIDER_PYTHON (or UV_TOOL_DIR) must be set for the shim to be used. The plain-CLI fallback (no shim) writes aider's default `.aider.*` files into the working repo.

notes: Conversation state is already role-private in shim mode (state_dir under the role's TMPDIR). The residual unknown is what aider itself writes outside state_dir (cache dirs, analytics id, .aider.* in the cwd), which needs a run on a host with aider.

Strategy: private-home with MONOMIND_AIDER_STATE_DIR and MONOMIND_AIDER_PYTHON (or UV_TOOL_DIR) pointed at the real install, marked unverified; if the plain-CLI fallback is allowed in sections, its `.aider.*` files in the cwd must be treated as role-owned.
